seo.title: Lexunder Inc Food to Live Organic SuperGrass Powd… Recalled
seo.description: Lexunder Inc is recalling Food to Live Organic SuperGrass Powder over a salmonella risk. Distribution: 41 states.

paragraphs: Lexunder Inc is recalling Food to Live Organic SuperGrass Powder because of a salmonella risk, according to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration. The recall was initiated on August 7, 2026.

body.heading: What is being recalled
paragraphs: Food to Live Organic SuperGrass Powder; 6 oz, 12 oz, 1 lb, 4 lb

body.heading: Where it was sold or distributed
paragraphs: AK, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DE, FL, GA, HI, IA, IL, IN, KY, LA, MA, MD, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, NE, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, RI, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, VI, WA, WI, WV, and U.S. Virgin Islands.

body.heading: What consumers should do
paragraphs: Consumers can review the FDA recall record for product and distribution details.

body.heading: Source
paragraphs: This article was produced from an official FDA recall record initiated on August 7, 2026. U.S. Food and Drug Administration is the original source of this recall notice.
